issues.observed: Samba exited with status 1 before binding when its state directories were under the long repository artifacts path; stdout did not provide a detailed error.

issues.verification: The revised process stays live and binds only 127.0.0.1:4458. Exact cause of the initial exit is not proven; path length remains a diagnosis hypothesis.

issues.verification: Android instrumentation now includes 22 preceding synthetic files; execution result is recorded separately after the APK is tested.

issues.observed: Activity-owned full snapshots could overwrite records written by the other activity; alias creation lacked a cross-instance lock.
issues.change: Serialize encrypted read-modify-write and key initialization using the same process-wide lock.
issues.verification: Production model transaction tests cover stale snapshots, concurrent writers, mutation failure and unreadable records. AndroidKeyStore execution is recorded separately.

Attempt 2 observed MediaPlayer prepared=true, playing=true, width=320 and position=40107 after a fixed 1.4-second wall-clock pause, failing the >200 ms media progression assertion.
issues.change: Retain both failure reports. Replace the fixed wall-clock performance assertion with a bounded 45-second wait for at least 250 ms of actual media-clock progression; allow 180 seconds for the actual MediaPlayer completion callback. Do not fabricate completion or modify product playback behavior.
issues.verification: Completion and playback correctness remain subject to the subsequent instrumentation result; this fixture does not establish real-device playback performance.
